description: Avalanche Disaster Dataset for the G219 Wenquan to Horgos Transportation Corridor (2024-2025) G219线温泉至霍尔果斯交通廊道2024-2025年雪崩灾害数据集 is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Wang Bin, zhao jing (新疆交通科学研究院有限责任公司). The section of National Highway G219 from Wenquan to Horgos is located in the Tianshan Mountains region of China. This area experiences heavy snowfall in winter and frequent avalanche disasters, resulting in an urgent need to conduct data investigation and analysis of avalanche disasters along the route. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3248074055 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
